screening_rules: The candidate must be a named legislative or administrative instrument, not a generic technology idea.
Current official text or action status and an official federal-cost path are required.
A candidate may be admitted as cost-only; no productivity, savings, or target-cost credit is inferred.
A stale prior-Congress bill may remain comparison context but cannot control the current candidate.
An existing current-law program without a scored incremental policy delta is not a reform candidate.
